title: Feature registry frontmatter
$comment: Additive history (WU 2.14, F2.4): Phase 1 baseline schema — correlation_id, state, involved_repos, autonomy_default, task_graph (tasks: id, type, depends_on, assigned_repo, autonomy). Phase 2 additions: optional required_templates array on task objects (WU 2.6) — generator template tokens the task needs from its assigned_repo; populated by the human during drafting or plan_review, never by the task-decomposition skill at v1. Reframe migration (naming-convention.md): additively accept the initiative/feature hierarchy — correlation_id now matches FEAT- (legacy feature) OR INIT- (initiative); ids match TNN OR FNN; the unit array may be `task_graph` (legacy) OR `feature_graph` (initiative listing its dispatched features). Exactly one of the two arrays is required. Existing FEAT-/task_graph/TNN files validate unchanged. Phase 3 next-step addition (2026-06-08): optional next_step object (summary, owner, owner_repo?, blocking_on?, updated) — required when state ∈ {planning, plan_review, generating, in_progress, blocked} via the conditional allOf at the root. Written by /initiative-status on every transition; regenerated by /roadmap-sync (stale-next-step auto-fix). Terminal states (done, abandoned) and pre-planning states (drafting, validating) are exempt. Pre-existing registries without next_step that sit in an exempt state validate unchanged; registries in a required state must be backfilled.
description: YAML frontmatter on a /features/<id>.md file. Fields are the machine-readable contract for feature/initiative state; prose in the body is for humans. See orchestrator-architecture.md §3 and §6.1 and docs/naming-convention.md.

correlation_id.description: Feature- or initiative-level correlation ID. FEAT-YYYY-NNNN (legacy feature) or INIT-YYYY-NNNN (initiative). Sub-unit IDs (TNN/FNN) are not valid here.

state.description: Current feature state from the feature state machine in §6.1.

involved_repos.description: Component repositories touched by this feature, as `owner/repo` strings.

autonomy_default.description: Feature-level autonomy default; may be overridden per task during plan review.

task_graph.description: Legacy (FEAT- feature) approved task graph. Each task has an ID, type, dependency list, and assigned repo. Use `feature_graph` for an INIT- initiative.

feature_graph.description: Initiative (INIT-) graph of dispatched features. Same shape as `task_graph`: each entry is a single-repo feature (id FNN, type, depends_on, assigned_repo) the orchestrator dispatches to a component-loop, which owns its internal gates and work units. See docs/naming-convention.md.

next_step.description: Human-readable next concrete action + responsible party. Single writer: /initiative-status (rewritten on every state transition); regenerator: /roadmap-sync (stale-next-step auto-fix). Required mid-lifecycle (see root allOf); exempt for drafting/validating/done/abandoned. The matching roadmap section (`**Next step.** / **Owner.** / **Blocking on.** / **Updated.**`) is the registry's projection — registry wins on drift.

summary.description: One-sentence concrete action (commands, issue numbers, repo names allowed). The action that, if taken, advances state — not a status report.

owner.description: Role responsible for performing `summary`. `human` = explicit human action required (review/approval/unblock). `component-loop` and `qa-agent` require `owner_repo`. `runner`/`qa-dispatcher` denote a script invocation a human runs.

owner_repo.description: `owner/repo` when `owner` is `component-loop` or `qa-agent`. Must appear in `involved_repos`.

blocking_on.description: Concrete trigger that would change `summary` (e.g. 'F03 reaching done', 'PR #290 merge', 'inbox/spec-issue/X resolved'). Absent = nothing external; next-step is actionable now.

updated.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the next_step was last rewritten. Stamped by /initiative-status on transition and by /roadmap-sync on regeneration.

id.description: Sub-unit ID local to the parent. TNN (legacy task under a FEAT- feature) or FNN (feature under an INIT- initiative). Combined with the parent correlation ID, this forms the sub-unit correlation ID.

depends_on.description: Sibling sub-unit IDs (TNN or FNN) within this parent that must reach `done` before this one becomes `ready`.

assigned_repo.description: `owner/repo` that will host this task's GitHub issue and (for implementation tasks) the resulting PR.

autonomy.description: Per-task autonomy override. If absent, the task inherits the feature-level `autonomy_default`. Set by the PM agent during task decomposition when safety policy requires a stricter level than the feature default (e.g. `qa_execution` is never `auto`), or by the human during plan review.

required_templates.description: Generator template tokens this task requires from its `assigned_repo`. Consumed by the PM agent's template-coverage-check skill (Phase 2 WU 2.6) to cross-reference against the repo's `.specfuse/templates.yaml` declaration. Tokens are free-form kebab-case strings; matching is exact-string. Absent or empty is treated as 'no generator templates needed for this task' and trivially satisfies coverage. Populated by the human during drafting or `plan_review`; the task-decomposition skill does not infer it at v1.
